scope: General neoclassical continuous-time Solow-Swan growth from positive capital: existence, positivity, uniqueness among nonnegative classical paths, strict monotone convergence, Lyapunov stability, all eight Acemoglu comparative-statics partials, Golden Rule saving, a stationary Cass bridge, saving shocks, effective-labour convergence, and Cobb-Douglas closed forms, absolute convergence among identical economies with a uniform exponential rate and the sharp asymptotic rate m - s f'(k*). A parallel discrete-time library (DiscreteTime/) redoes these results for k(t+1) = (s f(k) + (1 - delta) k)/gamma, following Acemoglu Propositions 2.2-2.6.
